第四章 线性模型入门

  1. 用均值对数据分布进行建模：知道均值就是知道数据总体的基本情况。 推测总体，平均数作为统计量最有价值 反应时和词频之间的关系：回归线 实验中的词只是一个样本，代表某一个词频的样本
knitr::include_graphics('./picture/图4.1.png')

  1. 截距和斜率 （1）正斜率和负斜率 \[ slope = \frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x} \] （2）仅靠斜率无法定义直线，还需要截距 系数估计值：回归分析的首要结果，得到斜率和截距的值以及解释它们对应的语言学含义。
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), bty = "l", oma = c(2.5, 0, 0, 0))
draw_axes <- function() {
  axis(1, at = -2:5)
  axis(2, at = -2:5, las = 1)
}
draw_box <- function(x0, y0, cex = 1.2) {
  points(x0, y0, pch = 15, col = "white", cex = cex)
  points(x0, y0, pch = 0, lwd = 1.5, cex = cex)
}

# (a) 相同截距、不同斜率（+0.5 与 -0.5）
plot(-2:5, -2:5, type = "n", xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n",
     xlab = "Predictor", ylab = "Response",
     main = "(a) Same intercept,\ndifferent slopes",
     xlim = c(-2, 5), ylim = c(-2, 5))
draw_axes()
abline(a = 1, b = 0.5, lwd = 2)
abline(a = 1, b = -0.5, lwd = 2)
abline(v = 0, lty = 3)
draw_box(0, 1)

# (b) 相同斜率、不同截距
plot(-2:5, -2:5, type = "n", xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n",
     xlab = "Predictor", ylab = "Response",
     main = "(b) Different intercepts,\nsame slope",
     xlim = c(-2, 5), ylim = c(-2, 5))
draw_axes()
abline(a = 1, b = 0.5, lwd = 2)
abline(a = 3, b = 0.5, lwd = 2)
abline(v = 0, lty = 3)
draw_box(0, 1); draw_box(0, 3)

# 图注
mtext("图4.2 (a) 正负斜率的两条线有相同的截距；(b) 相同斜率的两条线有不同的截距",
      side = 1, outer = TRUE, line = 0.5)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
  1. 拟合值和残差 script的词频是3，得出的反应时间是拟合值；有时拟合值没有意义（词频为0时，没有意义）

\[ \text{response duration} = 880\ \text{ms}+\left(-70\ \frac{\text{ms}}{\text{freq}}\right)\times3\ \text{freq} = 670\ \text{ms} \] \[ \text{观测值} = \text{拟合值}+\text{残差} \] \[ \text{残差} = \text{观测值}-\text{拟合值} \] \[ y = b_0+b_1x+e \] b0 + b1x 起决定性作用，x = 3时，拟合值是均值，实际单词的反应时间服从正态分布，并不一定是3

knitr::include_graphics('./picture/图4.3.png')

  1. 正态性和同方差假设 （1）正态性：残差近似正态分布，注意不是因变量。 （2）同方差性：沿回归线移动，残差的分布不变。
knitr::include_graphics('./picture/图4.4.png')

  1. R2 （1）拟合优度：残差是判断模型拟合优度的有利标准，反映一个模型在整体上与数据结果的拟合程度。 （2）残差平方和：线性模型的目的就是找到拟合优度最好、残差平方和最小的模型。
knitr::include_graphics('./picture/图4.5.png')

# 1. 模拟数据
set.seed(42)
n <- 60
x <- runif(n, 1, 9) 
y <- list(1 * x + 2 + rnorm(n, 0, 0.7),   # 对应 R2 ~ 0.9
          1 * x + 2 + rnorm(n, 0, 1.9),   # 对应 R2 ~ 0.6
          1 * x + 2 + rnorm(n, 0, 3.5))   # 对应 R2 ~ 0.3
r2_labels <- c("0.9", "0.6", "0.3")
# 2. 统一定制主题 
my_theme <- theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    aspect.ratio = 1, 
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )
# 3. 绘图函数
make_plot <- function(i) {
  ggplot(data.frame(x, y = y[[i]]), aes(x, y)) +
    geom_point(color = "#555555", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#444444", linewidth = 0.5, fullrange = TRUE) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 10), ylim = c(0, 12)) +
    labs(title = bquote(italic(R)^2 %~~% .(r2_labels[i]))) +
    my_theme
}
# 4. 循环生成三张图并拼合
p_list <- lapply(1:3, make_plot)
p_final <- wrap_plots(p_list, ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(                                          
    caption = "图4.6  不同斜率对应不同的残差平方和",          
    theme = theme(                                          
      plot.caption = element_text(                          
        hjust = 0.5,                                      
        size  = 13,                                       
        color = "black",                                       
        margin = margin(t = 12)               
      )                                                     
    )                                                       
  )                                                         

print(p_final)
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

（3）零模型：也叫做截距模型，不包括任何自变量的模型，使用因变量的均值代表因变量。常用来比较残差平方和是否有价值。例如：用身高预测体重，如果不使用身高做自变量和使用身高做自变量没什么区别，那么就不需要自变量了。

R²的计算公式： \[ R^2 = 1-\frac{SSE_{model}}{SSE_{null}} \] 用主模型 SSE 除以零模型 SSE，得到“标准化的残差比例”，再用1减去它，即可消除单位影响

set.seed(123) #设计一个随机种子
x <- rnorm(50)
# 生成 50 个服从标准正态分布 N(0,1) 的随机数，赋值给 x
y <- 3 * x + rnorm(50) # 误差项是 50 个标准正态随机数
xmd1 <- lm(y ~ x)  # 拟合线性回归模型
xmd1_null <- lm(y ~ 1)  # 拟合“零模型”
# 提取残差
res <- residuals(xmd1)  
res_null <- residuals(xmd1_null)
# 计算残差平方和
sum(res ^ 2)  
## [1] 40.12021
sum(res_null ^ 2) 
## [1] 409.3719
# 计算 R²（表示 y ~ x 模型相对于只用均值预测，解释了多少比例的变异）
1 - (sum(res ^ 2) / sum(res_null ^ 2))  
## [1] 0.9019957
# 与summary(xmd1)或glance(xmd1)输出的R²结果进行对比
glance(xmd1)$r.squared
## [1] 0.9019957
summary(xmd1)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = y ~ x)
## 
## Residuals:
##      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
## -2.46443 -0.48623 -0.02705  0.49405  2.02559 
## 
## Coefficients:
##             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)   0.1476     0.1294   1.141     0.26    
## x             2.9649     0.1411  21.018   <2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.9142 on 48 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.902,  Adjusted R-squared:    0.9 
## F-statistic: 441.8 on 1 and 48 DF,  p-value: < 2.2e-16

课堂练习： 先运行下面代码生成 “练习时长 — 听力成绩” 数据，然后完成要求： 拟合线性模型并手动计算R²

set.seed(123)
practice <- runif(20, 1, 10)                    # 每周练习时长（小时）
score <- 50 + 5 * practice + rnorm(20, sd = 6)  # 听力测试成绩
#题目答案
model <- lm(score ~ practice)

predicted <- predict(model)

SSE <- sum((score - predicted)^2)
SST <- sum((score - mean(score))^2)

R2 <- 1 - SSE / SST

R2
## [1] 0.8144435
summary(model)$r.squared
## [1] 0.8144435
  1. R简单线性回归模型
# 随机生成数据
set.seed(123)
x <- rnorm(50)
y <- 10 + 3 * x
error <- rnorm(50)
y_with_error <- 10 + 3 * x + error

# 设置画布为 1行 2列（也就是左右拼接）
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# 画第一张图（无残差）
plot(x, y, pch = 19, main = "无误差的完美线性关系", xlab = "x", ylab = "y")
# 画第二张图（有残差）
plot(x, y_with_error, pch = 19, main = "加入误差后的真实分布", xlab = "x", ylab = "y")

# 画完后，记得恢复默认画布设置，否则后面画的图都会挤在一起
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
xmd1 <- lm(y_with_error ~ x)
xmd1
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = y_with_error ~ x)
## 
## Coefficients:
## (Intercept)            x  
##      10.148        2.965
summary(xmd1)

## Call:
## lm(formula = y_with_error ~ x)
## 
## Residuals:
##      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
## -2.46443 -0.48623 -0.02705  0.49405  2.02559 
## 
## Coefficients:

## (Intercept)  10.1476     0.1294   78.43   <2e-16 ***

## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.9142 on 48 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.902,  Adjusted R-squared:    0.9 
## F-statistic: 441.8 on 1 and 48 DF,  p-value: < 2.2e-16
head(fitted(xmd1))

coef(xmd1)

coef(xmd1)[1]

  1. 线性模型与tidyverse函数
mydf <- tibble(x, y_with_error)
xmd1 <- lm(y_with_error ~ x, data = mydf)
tidy(xmd1)
## # A tibble: 2 × 5
##   term        estimate std.error statistic  p.value
##   <chr>          <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>
## 1 (Intercept)    10.1      0.129      78.4 2.48e-52
## 2 x               2.96     0.141      21.0 7.42e-26
tidy(xmd1)$estimate #模型估计值
## [1] 10.147615  2.964921
glance(xmd1) #查看模型指标
## # A tibble: 1 × 12
##   r.squared adj.r.squared sigma statistic  p.value    df logLik   AIC   BIC
##       <dbl>         <dbl> <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl> <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
## 1     0.902         0.900 0.914      442. 7.42e-26     1  -65.4  137.  143.
## # ℹ 3 more variables: deviance <dbl>, df.residual <int>, nobs <int>
mydf %>% ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y_with_error)) +
  geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = 'lm') +
  theme_minimal()
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

  1. 截距占位符 xmd1和xmd2是等价写法
xmd1 <- lm(y_with_error ~ x, data = mydf)
coef(xmd1)
## (Intercept)           x 
##   10.147615    2.964921
xmd2 <- lm(y_with_error ~ 1 + x, data = mydf)
coef(xmd2)
## (Intercept)           x 
##   10.147615    2.964921
xmdl_null <- lm(y_with_error ~ 1, data = mydf)
coef(xmdl_null)
## (Intercept) 
##    10.24962
mean(y_with_error) 
## [1] 10.24962

#######第五章####### 一 中心化 1. 线性变化和非线性变化 2. 线性变化：将每一个数据和平均数相减，尤其是连续变量

set.seed(1)
a <- runif(10)
m.a <- mean(a)
m.a
## [1] 0.5515139
a - m.a
##  [1] -0.28600521 -0.17938997  0.02133949  0.35669392 -0.34983194  0.34687581
##  [7]  0.39316140  0.10928392  0.07760017 -0.48972760
  1. 中心化对截距的含义有影响
knitr::include_graphics('./picture/图5.1.png')

二 标准化 1. 定义：将中心化后的数据再除以标准差

a1 <- c(460, 480, 500, 520, 540)
m.a1 <- mean(a1)
sd.a1 <- sd(a1)
(a1 - m.a1)/sd.a1
## [1] -1.2649111 -0.6324555  0.0000000  0.6324555  1.2649111
knitr::include_graphics('./picture/图5.2.png')

  1. 标准化的作用：消除量纲 高考成绩/四六级考试

三 通过对数变换描述数量级 1. 非线性变化会影响数据之间的关系 人类的反应时间通常是正偏态的，即我们无论如何也不可能反应时间是1ms

knitr::include_graphics('./picture/图5.4.png')

log10(100)
## [1] 2
log10(1000)
## [1] 3
RTs <- c(600, 650, 700, 1000, 4000)
RTs
## [1]  600  650  700 1000 4000
logRTs <- log(RTs)
logRTs
## [1] 6.396930 6.476972 6.551080 6.907755 8.294050
exp(logRTs)

四 实例：反应时间与词频

ELP <- read_csv('ELP_frequency.csv')
## Rows: 12 Columns: 3
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr (1): Word
## dbl (2): Freq, RT
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
ELP <- mutate(ELP,
              Log10Freq = log10(Freq),
              LogRT = log(RT))

p1 <- ggplot(ELP, aes(x = Freq)) + 
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) + labs(title = "Freq")
p2 <- ggplot(ELP, aes(x = Log10Freq)) + 
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) + labs(title = "Log10Freq")
p3 <- ggplot(ELP, aes(x = RT)) + 
  geom_density(fill = "tomato", alpha = 0.5) + labs(title = "RT")
p4 <- ggplot(ELP, aes(x = LogRT)) + 
  geom_density(fill = "tomato", alpha = 0.5) + labs(title = "LogRT")

(p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4)   # 2 行 2 列

ELP %>% ggplot(aes(x = Freq, y = LogRT, label = Word)) +
  geom_text() +
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm') +
  ggtitle('Log RT ~ raw frequency') +
  theme_minimal()
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
## Warning: The following aesthetics were dropped during statistical transformation: label.
## ℹ This can happen when ggplot fails to infer the correct grouping structure in
##   the data.

ELP %>% ggplot(aes(x = Log10Freq, y = LogRT, label = Word)) +
  geom_text() +
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm') +
  ggtitle('Log RT ~ raw frequency') +
  theme_minimal()
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

ELP_mdl <- lm(LogRT ~ Log10Freq, data = ELP)
tidy(ELP_mdl)
## # A tibble: 2 × 5

## 2 Log10Freq     -0.104    0.0201     -5.20 4.03e- 4
summary(ELP_mdl)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = LogRT ~ Log10Freq, data = ELP)
## 
## Residuals:
##      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
## -0.12744 -0.06603  0.01191  0.05207  0.13589 
## 
## Coefficients:
##             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)  6.79128    0.06113 111.091  < 2e-16 ***
## Log10Freq   -0.10425    0.02006  -5.197 0.000403 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1

## F-statistic:    27 on 1 and 10 DF,  p-value: 0.0004033
b0 <- tidy(ELP_mdl)$estimate[1] # 截距
b1 <- tidy(ELP_mdl)$estimate[2] # 斜率
#预测log词频为1和3的词的反应时间
logRT_10freq <- b0 + b1 * 1
logRT_1000freq <- b0 + b1 * 3
logRT_10freq
## [1] 6.687032
logRT_1000freq
## [1] 6.478534
exp(logRT_10freq)
## [1] 801.9387

五 在R语言中进行标准化和中心化

#手动计算进行标准化和中心化
ELP <- mutate(ELP,
              Log10Freq_c = Log10Freq - mean(Log10Freq),
              Log10Freq_z = Log10Freq_c / sd(Log10Freq_c))
select(ELP, Freq, Log10Freq, Log10Freq_c, Log10Freq_z)
## # A tibble: 12 × 4
##     Freq Log10Freq Log10Freq_c Log10Freq_z
##    <dbl>     <dbl>       <dbl>       <dbl>
##  1 55522     4.74        2.03       1.41  
##  2 40629     4.61        1.89       1.31  
##  3 14895     4.17        1.46       1.01  
##  4  3992     3.60        0.884      0.614 
##  5  3850     3.59        0.868      0.603 
##  6   409     2.61       -0.106     -0.0736
##  7   241     2.38       -0.336     -0.233 
##  8   238     2.38       -0.341     -0.237 
##  9    66     1.82       -0.898     -0.624 
## 10    32     1.51       -1.21      -0.842 
## 11     4     0.602      -2.12      -1.47  
## 12     4     0.602      -2.12      -1.47
#使用自带函数进行标准化和中心化
ELP <- mutate(ELP,
              Log10Freq_c = scale(Log10Freq, scale = FALSE),
              Log10Freq_z = scale(Log10Freq))

中心化和原模型：斜率不变，截距变化 标准化和中心化：截距不变，斜率变化 标准化和原模型：斜率和截距都会变化

ELP_mdl_c <- lm(LogRT ~ Log10Freq_c, ELP)
ELP_mdl_z <- lm(LogRT ~ Log10Freq_z, ELP)

tidy(ELP_mdl) %>% select(term, estimate)
## # A tibble: 2 × 2
##   term        estimate
##   <chr>          <dbl>
## 1 (Intercept)    6.79 
## 2 Log10Freq     -0.104
tidy(ELP_mdl_c) %>% select(term, estimate)
## # A tibble: 2 × 2
##   term        estimate
##   <chr>          <dbl>
## 1 (Intercept)    6.51 
## 2 Log10Freq_c   -0.104
tidy(ELP_mdl_z) %>% select(term, estimate)
## # A tibble: 2 × 2
##   term        estimate
##   <chr>          <dbl>
## 1 (Intercept)    6.51 
## 2 Log10Freq_z   -0.150
glance(ELP_mdl)$r.squared
## [1] 0.7297624
glance(ELP_mdl_c)$r.squared
## [1] 0.7297624
glance(ELP_mdl_z)$r.squared
## [1] 0.7297624
glance(lm(LogRT ~ Freq, ELP))$r.squared
## [1] 0.2914014

#######第六章####### 一 含一个以上预测变量的回归

\[ y = b_0 + b_1 x + b_2 x + \ldots + e \]

\[ RT = 900\ \text{ms} + (-90) * \log \text{frequency} \]

\[ RT = b_0 + b_1 *\log\text{frequency} + b_2 * \text{word length} \]

\[ RT = 750\mathrm{ms} + (-70) * \text{frequency} + 20 * \text{length} \]

有时截距没有意义：以身高体重(身高体重不为零)预测学习成绩 有时截距有意义：以收入和饭量（收入和饭量可以为零）预测学习成绩

二 多元回归与标准化系数

icon <- read_csv('perry_winter_2017_iconicity.csv')
## Rows: 3001 Columns: 8
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr (2): Word, POS
## dbl (6): SER, CorteseImag, Conc, Syst, Freq, Iconicity
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
icon %>% print(n = 4, width = Inf)
## # A tibble: 3,001 × 8
##   Word  POS           SER CorteseImag  Conc  Syst    Freq Iconicity
##   <chr> <chr>       <dbl>       <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>   <dbl>     <dbl>

## 2 abide Verb        NA             NA  1.68    NA     138     0.25

## 4 about Grammatical  1.2           NA  1.77    NA  185206    -0.1  
## # ℹ 2,997 more rows
icon <- mutate(icon, Log10Freq = log10(Freq))   
icon_mdl <- lm(Iconicity ~ SER + CorteseImag + Syst + Log10Freq, data = icon)
glance(icon_mdl)$r.squared
## [1] 0.2124559
tidy(icon_mdl) %>% select(term, estimate) %>%
    mutate(estimate = round(estimate, 1))

## 2 SER              0.5
## 3 CorteseImag     -0.3

三 评估假设 1. 正态性：残差的分布符合正态分布 2. 方差等分散性：不同拟合值的残差没有明显变化，当只有一个自变量时，可以用x作为横轴

res <- residuals(icon_mdl_z)
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
hist(res)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
plot(fitted(icon_mdl_z), res)

par(mfrow = c(3, 3)) # 好的
for (i in 1:9) plot(rnorm(50), rnorm(50))

par(mfrow = c(3, 3)) # 不好的
for (i in 1:9) plot(1:50, (1:50) * rnorm(50))

四 共线性 1. 定义：一个预测变量会对另一个预测变量进行预测 假设身高可以预测学习成绩，然后你用身高和体重都预测学习成绩，就会出现共线性，因为身高体重高相关

set.seed(42)
x <- rnorm(50)
y <- 10 + 3 * x + rnorm(50) # 生成因变量
tidy(lm(y ~ x))
## # A tibble: 2 × 5
##   term        estimate std.error statistic  p.value
##   <chr>          <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>
## 1 (Intercept)    10.1      0.128      78.6 2.22e-52
## 2 x               2.81     0.113      24.9 3.96e-29
x2 <- x #生成一个新变量
x2[50] <- -1
cor(x, x2) # 两个变量高相关
## [1] 0.9793935
tidy(lm(y ~ x2))
## # A tibble: 2 × 5
##   term        estimate std.error statistic  p.value
##   <chr>          <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>
## 1 (Intercept)    10.2      0.167      61.0 3.83e-47
## 2 x2              2.72     0.146      18.7 1.12e-23
xmdl_both <- lm(y ~ x + x2)
tidy(xmdl_both)
## # A tibble: 3 × 5
##   term        estimate std.error statistic  p.value
##   <chr>          <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>
## 1 (Intercept)   10.1       0.130    77.3   3.35e-51
## 2 x              3.23      0.560     5.76  6.16e- 7
## 3 x2            -0.426     0.558    -0.762 4.50e- 1
library(car)
## Loading required package: carData
## 
## Attaching package: 'car'
## The following object is masked from 'package:dplyr':
## 
##     recode
## The following object is masked from 'package:purrr':
## 
##     some
vif(xmdl_both)
##        x       x2 
## 24.51677 24.51677
icon_mdl_z <- lm(Iconicity ~ SER_z + CorteseImag_z + Syst_z + Freq_z, data = icon)
vif(icon_mdl_z)
##         SER_z CorteseImag_z        Syst_z        Freq_z 
##      1.148597      1.143599      1.015054      1.020376

练习

ELP <- read.csv(
  "ELP_full_length_frequency.csv"
)

model <- lm(RT ~ Log10Freq + length, data = ELP)

summary(model)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = RT ~ Log10Freq + length, data = ELP)
## 
## Residuals:
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -410.24  -60.52   -9.71   48.01  705.53 
## 
## Coefficients:
##             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept) 748.4261     2.1761  343.92   <2e-16 ***
## Log10Freq   -68.0225     0.5939 -114.54   <2e-16 ***
## length       19.4583     0.2377   81.86   <2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 89.09 on 33072 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.4873, Adjusted R-squared:  0.4873 
## F-statistic: 1.572e+04 on 2 and 33072 DF,  p-value: < 2.2e-16
car::vif(model)
## Log10Freq    length 
##  1.167489  1.167489
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

hist(residuals(model), breaks = 60,
     main = "Residual histogram",
     xlab = "Residuals")

qqnorm(residuals(model))
qqline(residuals(model), col = "red")

plot(fitted(model), residuals(model),
     xlab = "Fitted values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     pch = 16, cex = 0.2)

abline(h = 0, col = "red")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
